subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Fight shy of
solution:
The correct answer is **To avoid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fight shy of: **​try to avoid something.

 
 
• **Example: **Arjun is naturally a peacemaker, so he always **fights shy of** tension. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is expressed in **option 2**.
